news: - Press **Leave & Notify Clan Members** instead of Disconnect.
- It posts your loot and shield time to Discord, then leaves.
- Shield almost gone? It asks the clan for help.
- Every raid counts: gold, amethyst, stars, attacks.
- Counting starts now - older raids aren't included.
- Mob faces show up after your first raid with them.
- Joining or leaving the clan is posted to the clan.
